items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I remember so many of the names, Ward Pinkut for one, trumpet player.

ctx.x: It's April 17, 1980 and we're resuming our interview with Cozy Cole, the great jazz drummer and we took an overnight break. In the process Cozy got to listen to some tapes of some things he hasn't heard in a while, and he got to also look at John Charlton's Who's Who in Jazz. And that brought some memories--what did that all bring to mind, Cozy?
Well when I was reading the discography there, I remember so many of the names, Ward Pinkut for one, trumpet player.
